# Question 2

## Question 2.1

$$
\begin{split}
\hat{livespan} = 11.5+2.0*weight + 1.5*carnivore − 1.2*omnivore\\
\hat{livespan_a} = 11.5 + 2.0*weight+1.5⋅carnivore\\
\hat{livespan_b} = 11.5+ 2.0*(weight-5)+1.5⋅carnivore
\end{split}
$$

$$
\begin{split}
\hat{livespan_a} - \hat{livespan_b} & = 2.0*weight - 2.0*(weight-5) \\
& = 2 * weight - 2* weight + -2 * -5 \\
& = 10
\end{split}
$$

## Question 2.2

$$
\begin{split}
\hat{livespan_a} = 11.5 + 2.0 * weight\\
\hat{livespan_b} = 11.5 + 2.0 * weight +1.5
\end{split}
$$ $$
\begin{split}
\hat{livespan_a} - \hat{livespan_b} & = 1.5
\end{split}
$$
